# open-ocean

> Free community system and private Full Ocean integration/runtime builder for the ellmos ecosystem.

## Product boundary

- OPEN OCEAN = PUBLIC
- PRIVATE OCEAN = PRIVATE, NON-PROPRIETARY
- FULL OCEAN = OPEN OCEAN + PRIVATE OCEAN
- SPEEDBOAT is an independent proprietary sibling stack with explicit shared-component allowlists.

## Current private Full Ocean development state

- Accepted workspaces:
  - ASUS-GEI: `C:\_Local_DEV\ocean-full`
  - WORKSTATION-LG: `C:\_Local_DEV\ocean-full` (fresh install, 2026-08-30)
- Product URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8810/control/`
- Composition: 28/28 verified bundles, 54/65 resolved modules, 80/80 resolved skills
- Required gaps: 0; optional unresolved module references: 11
- Product identity: `OCEAN Full Dev`; no TerminPilot product surface on the OCEAN origin
- Logon task `EllmosOceanFullUserStart`, hidden limited-user action pinned to the accepted tag,
  verified on both ASUS-GEI and WORKSTATION-LG
- BACH session sidecar: stopped on ASUS-GEI after OCEAN/autostart acceptance; never running on
  WORKSTATION-LG, so nothing was stopped there
- This is not an OPEN OCEAN release, BACH-parity claim, visibility change or permission to remove
  `PRIVATE.txt`.

## Lifecycle CLI

```text
python ocean.py plan <composition arguments>
python ocean.py up <composition arguments> --apply
python ocean.py start --workspace <local-sandbox>
python ocean.py start <role> --manifest <ellmos-module.v2.json> [--provider <name>]
python ocean.py status --workspace <local-sandbox>
python ocean.py user add --workspace <local-sandbox> --username <name> --email <address>
python ocean.py down --workspace <local-sandbox>
```

Use `python ocean.py --help` and subcommand help for the complete argument surface.
The positional role path delegates to `python -m unified_gui.console start` and
never enters the installed-runtime lifecycle. Its explicit fallback order is
task-master, COMA, then the module-declared starter.

## Project Information

- **Repository**: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-ocean
- **Organization**: ellmos-ai
- **License**: MIT
- **Last Checked**: 2026-09-12
- **Language**: Python 3.10+
- **Package / CLI**: `open-ocean` (v0.1.2)
- **Security & Privacy**: Local-first, zero egress, fail-closed verification, transactional rollback, unprivileged user mode. Full policy in [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).
- **CI / Testing**: Multi-OS & multi-version GitHub Actions workflow in [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml).
- **Verified Suite**: 180 tests and 2 subtests passed on Windows on the integrated PR #2 tree on 2026-09-09; Ruff and `compileall` passed. POSIX skips the Windows-only temporary-file cleanup regression while exercising the same fail-closed `icacls` result handling through mocks.

## Overview

`open-ocean` carries the architecture and first executable system-building layer of the ellmos community full system. It orchestrates the four-stage lifecycle:
1. **Resolve**: Expand bundle references from `open-ocean.skeleton.v1.json` into component manifests.
2. **Verify**: Cryptographically verify bundle manifests against pinned SHA-256 hashes before any write operation.
3. **Fetch & Place**: Securely fetch SHA-pinned components into a designated workspace without silent unpinned fallbacks.
4. **Activate & Roll Back**: Deploy sandboxed skill adapters and log all atomic operations to `ocean-dev.activation-log.json`, enabling strict reverse-order rollbacks.

## Safety & Invariants

- **INV-LOCAL-01 (Zero Egress)**: Manifest parsing, SHA validation, module placement, and skill activation occur entirely offline without external telemetry.
- **INV-TRANS-02 (Transactional Rollback)**: All filesystem mutations are recorded in an activation log and rolled back in exact reverse order without heuristic guessing.
- **INV-DRY-03 (Dry-Run First)**: Dry-run preview is the enforced default; file modification requires explicit `--apply`.
- **INV-PIN-04 (SHA-256 Pinning)**: Every bundle manifest and component reference is cryptographically verified; fails closed on any mismatch.
- **INV-SAND-05 (Sandboxed Activation)**: `--skills-dir` defaults to `<workspace>/skills` (never a live agent's active configuration directory like `~/.claude/skills`).
- **INV-PRIV-06 (Non-Elevation)**: All tools run strictly in user space without requiring administrative or root elevation.
- **INV-GATE-07 (Publication Gate)**: Publication gate formally lifted per D-20260909-003 / user directive; release conditions and audit log preserved.
- **INV-PARITY-08 (Conservation Law)**: Extraction changes the bed, never the water; strict functional parity against BACH baseline.
- **INV-PLAT-09 (Cross-Platform Parity)**: Universal execution across Linux, Windows, and macOS with normalized path handling.
- **INV-SLA-10 (48h / 5d Security SLA)**: Vulnerability reports acknowledged within 48 hours with a 5-business-day triage guarantee.

## Repository Structure

```
architecture/
  open-ocean.skeleton.v1.json          Declarative recipe consumption specification pinned by hash
  INSTALLER-TARGET.md                  Installer invariant rules and anti-patterns
  OCEAN-DEV-BUILD-PLAN_2026-08-18.md   Staged build plan and verification evidence
  BACH-EXTRACTION-ROADMAP.md           Extraction roadmap, parity gates, and Cluster 9 map
  bach-parity-baseline.v1.json         Machine-readable registry baseline
  bach-k9-data-contract.v1.json        Data snapshot and transaction contract
  bach-k9-dbsync-adapter.v1.json       Lifecycle-adapter specification
  session-checkpoint-capability.v1.json Snapshot carrier boundary
tools/
  ocean_dev.py                         Single entry point: Resolve -> Verify -> Fetch/Place -> Activate / Rollback
  resolve_bundles.py                   Resolve & Verify: bundle references -> flat, hash-checked component plan
  fetch_place.py                       Fetch & Place: SHA-pinned module placement
  host_adapters.py                     Vendor-neutral host activation (Claude Code reference adapter)
  audit_bach_handlers.py               Side-effect-free source audit against baseline
  check_k9_data_contract.py            Static data contract verification & carrier fixtures
tests/
  test_audit_bach_handlers.py          Handler audit tests
  test_check_k9_data_contract.py       K9 data contract tests
  test_fetch_place.py                  Fetch and place tests
  test_host_adapters.py                Host adapter activation and rollback tests
  test_ocean_dev.py                    Lifecycle and CLI integration tests
  test_resolve_bundles.py              Bundle resolution and hash validation tests
  test_metadata.py                     Automated contract tests for CI, metadata, security, and documentation
```

## Usage

```bash
# Dry-run preview (default)
python tools/ocean_dev.py --bundles-root <path-to-bundles> --ring 1

# Execute live activation into sandboxed workspace
python tools/ocean_dev.py --bundles-root <path-to-bundles> --ring 1 --apply

# Roll back all changes recorded in activation log
python tools/ocean_dev.py --rollback <path-to-workspace>/ocean-dev.activation-log.json
```
